subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: what causes day and night?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: din aur raat kis wajah se hote hain?
answer: The Earth spinning on its axis: the half facing the Sun has day and the other half has night.

subject: evs
prompt_en: A tree near your school loses almost all its leaves in March and then gets fresh new leaves in April. What is happening? Is the tree dead?
prompt_hi: School ke paas ka ek ped March mein lagbhag saare patte gira deta hai aur April mein us pe naye taaze patte aa jaate hain. Kya ho raha hai? Kya ped mar gaya tha?
answer: No, it is alive. Many trees shed their old leaves in the dry season and grow new ones; it is a seasonal change.

subject: evs
prompt_en: In a dark room, shine a torch straight down on a sheet of paper, then tilt it so the light falls at a slant. Draw around the lit patch each time. Predict: which patch will be smaller and brighter?
prompt_hi: Andhere kamre mein ek kaagaz pe torch seedha upar se daalo, phir use tircha karo taaki roshni tirchi gire. Har baar roshan hisse ke chaaron taraf line kheencho. Guess karo: kaunsa hissa chhota aur zyada chamakdaar hoga?
answer: The straight-down light makes a smaller, brighter patch; the slanting light spreads over a bigger area and is dimmer. In summer sunlight falls on us more directly, like the straight torch, so the ground heats more.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Predict: is the Earth closer to the Sun in June or in January?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: Prithvi Suraj ke zyada paas June mein hoti hai ya January mein?
answer: In January. The Earth is closest to the Sun in early January, when India has winter, so distance is not what makes summer; the tilt is.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Mark the tip of your shadow at 12 noon on a sunny day in May, and again in December, standing on the same spot. Predict: in which month will your noon shadow be longer?
prompt_hi: May ke ek dhoop wale din dopahar 12 baje apni parchhaai ka sira nishaan karo, aur December mein usi jagah khade hoke phir se. Guess karo: kis mahine dopahar ki parchhaai lambi hogi?
answer: In December. The noon Sun is lower in the sky in winter, so shadows are longer; in May it is high, so the noon shadow is short.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why are summer days longer than winter days in India?
prompt_hi: India mein garmi ke din sardi ke dinon se lambe kyon hote hain?
answer: In summer our half of the Earth leans towards the Sun, so our place spends more of each spin in sunlight; in winter it leans away, so days are shorter. In Delhi a June day is about 14 hours long and a December day about 10 hours.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why do birds like bar-headed geese and many ducks fly to lakes in India in winter?
prompt_hi: Bar-headed geese aur kai batakhein sardi mein India ki jheelon mein kyon aati hain?
answer: Their homes in colder lands to the north, such as Central Asia, Mongolia and Siberia, freeze in winter and food becomes hard to find; India's winter is milder, with open water and food. They fly back in spring to breed.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Compare December in Delhi with December in Sydney, Australia. What is the weather like in each, and why?
prompt_hi: Delhi ke December aur Sydney (Australia) ke December ki tulna karo. Dono jagah mausam kaisa hota hai, aur kyon?
answer: Delhi has winter, cold and foggy; Sydney has summer, hot and sunny, because in December the southern half of the Earth leans towards the Sun while the northern half leans away.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Start a 'seasons diary' for one tree near your home, such as a mango or neem. What changes would you expect to record across the year?
prompt_hi: Ghar ke paas ke ek ped, jaise aam ya neem, ki 'mausam diary' shuru karo. Saal bhar mein usmein kya badlaav likhne ki ummeed karoge?
answer: For example, mango: flowers (baur) from January to March, small green mangoes in spring, ripe fruit in summer, fresh green leaves in the monsoon. Neem: old leaves fall and new leaves and small white flowers come in spring, fruits in the monsoon.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Farmers in Punjab sow wheat in winter and rice in the monsoon. Why do the seasons decide which crop is grown?
prompt_hi: Punjab ke kisaan sardi mein gehoon aur monsoon mein dhaan (chawal) bote hain. Mausam ye kyon tay karta hai ki kaunsi fasal ugaayi jaaye?
answer: Rice needs a lot of water and warmth, which the monsoon gives; wheat grows best in cool weather with less water and is harvested in spring.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Draw a year-wheel with 12 months. Colour the seasons and draw one change in nature for each season: a tree, a bird, an insect or the weather.
prompt_hi: 12 mahino ka ek saal-chakra banao. Mausam ke hisaab se rang bharo aur har mausam ke liye prakriti ka ek badlaav banao: ek ped, ek pakshi, ek keeda ya mausam.
answer: Summer (March to June): hot, amaltas flowers, mangoes. Monsoon (June to September): rain, frogs, green grass. Autumn (October to November): clear skies, harvest. Winter (December to February): cold, fog, migratory birds. Spring: new leaves, palash flowers.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Pinky says, 'It's hot in summer because the Earth goes very close to the Sun.' What's wrong?
prompt_hi: Pinky kehti hai, 'Garmi isliye hoti hai kyonki Prithvi Suraj ke bahut paas chali jaati hai.' Galti kya hai?
answer: Seasons come from the Earth's tilt, not its distance; the Earth is actually closest to the Sun in early January, during our winter. Also, the two halves of the Earth have opposite seasons at the same time, which distance cannot explain.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Explain to a friend why we have summer and winter, using a torch and a ball to show it.
prompt_hi: Ek dost ko torch aur ball se dikhaate hue samjhao ki garmi aur sardi kyon hoti hai.
answer: The Earth's axis is tilted. As it goes around the Sun, our half leans towards the Sun in summer, so light falls more directly, like the straight torch, and days are longer; in winter it leans away, light slants and spreads, and days are short. It is not about distance, and the southern half has the opposite season.

subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: in which season do many birds fly to India from colder lands?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: kis mausam mein bahut se pakshi thande deshon se India aate hain?
answer: Winter.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Name a river or an animal that travels across more than one country.
prompt_hi: Ek aisi nadi ya jaanwar ka naam batao jo ek se zyada deshon se guzarta hai.
answer: Rivers: the Brahmaputra (Tibet, India, Bangladesh), the Ganga (India, Bangladesh), the Indus (Tibet, India, Pakistan). Animals: the Amur falcon, the bar-headed goose, the Olive Ridley turtle.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Put a few drops of food colour into one corner of a big bowl of still water. Do not stir. Predict: after 30 minutes, will the colour stay in that corner?
prompt_hi: Ek bade katore ke shaant paani ke ek kone mein khaane ke rang ki kuch boondein daalo. Hilaana mat. Guess karo: 30 minute baad kya rang usi kone mein rahega?
answer: No, it slowly spreads through the water. Pollution that enters water in one place also spreads to other places.

subject: evs
prompt_en: A factory on a river dumps dirty waste. Village A is upstream of the factory and Village B is downstream. Predict which village's fish and drinking water will be harmed.
prompt_hi: Nadi kinaare ki ek factory ganda kachra nadi mein daalti hai. Gaon A factory se upar ki taraf (upstream) hai aur Gaon B neeche ki taraf (downstream). Guess karo kis gaon ki machhliyon aur peene ke paani ko nuksaan hoga.
answer: Village B, downstream, because the river carries the waste down with its flow.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Open a jar of strong-smelling achaar in one corner of a closed room. Predict: will someone sitting in the far corner smell it? Roughly how long might it take?
prompt_hi: Ek band kamre ke ek kone mein tez khushboo wale achaar ka martaban kholo. Guess karo: door kone mein baitha koi use soongh payega? Lagbhag kitna samay lagega?
answer: Yes, after a little while, usually a few minutes, because the smell spreads through the air. Smoke and harmful gases from a chimney spread through the air in the same way.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Amur falcons fly from Russia and China, rest in Nagaland, then fly on to Africa. Why must several countries protect them, not just one?
prompt_hi: Amur falcon Russia aur China se udte hain, Nagaland mein aaraam karte hain, phir Africa tak jaate hain. Inhe sirf ek desh nahi, kai deshon ko kyon bachaana chahiye?
answer: Because they use places in many countries; if they are hunted or lose their resting places in any one country on the route, many can die. Every country on the route must keep them safe; villages in Nagaland now protect them.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why should a city that is cutting down a forest think about animals too?
prompt_hi: Jo shehar jungle kaat raha hai, use jaanwaron ke baare mein bhi kyon sochna chahiye?
answer: Animals depend on the forest for food, water and shelter; it is their home as much as ours. Forests also give everyone clean air and water.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Compare a small pond in a closed garden with the ocean. If a plastic bottle is dropped into each, where might each bottle end up?
prompt_hi: Band bageeche ke chhote taalab aur samudra ki tulna karo. Agar dono mein ek-ek plastic bottle gir jaaye, toh har bottle kahaan pahunch sakti hai?
answer: In the pond it stays in the pond and harms the life there. In the ocean, currents can carry it thousands of kilometres to other countries' beaches, where it harms sea animals far away.

subject: evs
prompt_en: A neighbour burns dry leaves and garbage in the lane. Who else is affected besides that neighbour?
prompt_hi: Ek padosi gali mein sukhe patte aur kachra jalaate hain. Us padosi ke alaawa aur kis-kis pe asar padta hai?
answer: Everyone nearby who breathes the smoke: families, children, elderly people and people with breathing problems, and birds and animals too; the smoke drifts into other homes and streets. Burning plastic is especially harmful.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Olive Ridley turtles swim across the ocean to lay eggs on Odisha's beaches. Bright lights and plastic on the beach confuse and harm them. What could a beach town do to share the beach with them?
prompt_hi: Olive Ridley kachhue samudra paar karke Odisha ke beach pe ande dene aate hain. Beach ki tez roshni aur plastic unhe bhatkaati aur nuksaan pahunchaati hai. Ek beach shehar unke saath beach baantne ke liye kya kar sakta hai?
answer: Switch off or shade bright beach lights during nesting season; keep the beach free of plastic and old nets; protect nesting areas; let volunteers guard the nests and help hatchlings reach the sea; keep fishing boats away from nesting waters.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Draw a map with two countries, a river flowing from one into the other, a factory chimney and a flock of birds. Use arrows to show how smoke, dirty water and birds cross the border.
prompt_hi: Ek map banao jismein do desh hon, ek nadi jo ek desh se doosre mein behti ho, ek factory ki chimney aur pakshiyon ka jhund. Teer se dikhao ki dhuaan, ganda paani aur pakshi seema kaise paar karte hain.
answer: Smoke arrows drift with the wind across the border; the river carries waste downstream into the next country; bird arrows fly both ways; the border line stops none of the arrows.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Chintu says, 'If one town dirties its river, that's only that town's problem.' What's wrong?
prompt_hi: Chintu kehta hai, 'Agar koi shehar apni nadi gandi kare, toh ye sirf us shehar ki pareshaani hai.' Galti kya hai?
answer: Rivers keep flowing: the dirty water reaches the towns, fields and animals downstream and finally the sea, so pollution in one place affects many others.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Explain to a younger child why the Earth is 'our shared home', with one example of air, one of water and one of an animal.
prompt_hi: Ek chhote bachche ko samjhao ki Prithvi 'hamara saanjha ghar' kyon hai, hawa, paani aur kisi jaanwar ki ek-ek misaal dekar.
answer: All living things share the Earth's air, water and land. Air: smoke from one place drifts to others. Water: a river carries pollution downstream and across countries. Animals: birds like the Amur falcon fly across many countries and need everyone's protection.

subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: name one thing that can carry pollution from one place to another far away.
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: ek cheez batao jo pradooshan ko ek jagah se door doosri jagah le ja sakti hai.
answer: Wind or moving air, rivers or flowing water, ocean currents.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Put these in order from best to least good for the Earth: recycle a plastic bottle; refuse a plastic bottle and carry your own; reuse a plastic bottle as a planter.
prompt_hi: Inhe dharti ke liye sabse achhe se kam achhe ke kram mein lagao: plastic bottle recycle karna; plastic bottle lena hi mana karke apni bottle le jaana; plastic bottle ko gamla bana ke dobara use karna.
answer: Refuse it and carry your own, then reuse it as a planter, then recycle it. Not making waste comes first, then reusing, then recycling.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Predict first: if each of the 40 students in your class uses a cloth bag instead of one plastic bag every day for a year, about how many plastic bags are saved: about 400, about 4,000 or about 14,000? Then work it out.
prompt_hi: Pehle guess karo: agar tumhari class ke 40 bachche saal bhar roz ek plastic thaili ki jagah kapde ka thaila use karein, toh lagbhag kitni plastic thailiyaan bachengi: lagbhag 400, lagbhag 4,000 ya lagbhag 14,000? Phir hisaab lagao.
answer: 40 times 365 is 14,600, so about 14,000 bags or more in a year.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Keep a bucket under the tap while you brush your teeth with the tap running for 2 minutes, then use that water for plants. Before you start, predict: will the bucket collect about one mug, or many mugs?
prompt_hi: Brush karte waqt 2 minute tak nal khula chhodo aur neeche baalti rakho, phir woh paani paudhon mein daal dena. Shuru karne se pehle guess karo: baalti mein lagbhag ek mug paani jama hoga, ya kai mug?
answer: Usually many mugs, often several litres, while brushing with the tap closed and one mug of water needs only about one mug.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Two saplings are planted in July in the rains. One gets regular water and a tree guard; the other is planted beside a path where goats graze and then forgotten. Predict which one will still be alive next summer.
prompt_hi: July ki baarish mein do paudhe lagaaye gaye. Ek ko roz paani aur tree guard mila; doosra us raaste ke kinaare lagaaya gaya jahaan bakriyaan charti hain, aur phir use bhool gaye. Guess karo agli garmi tak kaunsa zinda rahega.
answer: The cared-for one. Saplings need water until their roots grow deep, and protection from animals and trampling; the forgotten one is likely to be eaten or to dry up in summer.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why is 'refuse and reduce' better than 'recycle'?
prompt_hi: 'Mana karna aur kam karna' recycle karne se behtar kyon hai?
answer: If we do not use the item, no waste is made at all and no materials or energy are used; recycling still uses energy and water, and much plastic never actually gets recycled.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why should we never burn plastic or garbage?
prompt_hi: Hume plastic ya kachra kabhi kyon nahi jalaana chahiye?
answer: Burning plastic gives out poisonous smoke that harms everyone's lungs and pollutes the air; it does not make the waste disappear safely.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Compare two plans. Plan A: 'I will be good to the Earth.' Plan B: 'For 7 days I will carry a cloth bag and a steel bottle, and tick a chart every evening.' Which is more likely to work, and why?
prompt_hi: Do plan ki tulna karo. Plan A: 'Main dharti ke liye achha banunga.' Plan B: '7 din tak main kapde ka thaila aur steel ki bottle le jaaunga, aur roz shaam chart pe tick karunga.' Kaunsa plan zyada kaam karega, aur kyon?
answer: Plan B: it is specific and small, has a time limit and a way to check progress; Plan A is vague, so it is easy to forget.

subject: evs
prompt_en: There is a birthday party at your home. Suggest three ways to make it low-waste.
prompt_hi: Tumhare ghar pe birthday party hai. Ise kam kachre wali banaane ke 3 tareeke batao.
answer: Any three: steel plates and glasses or leaf plates instead of plastic; no balloons or plastic decorations, or decorations that can be reused; return gifts without plastic packing; sort waste into wet and dry; compost the leftovers; ask guests to bring their own bottles.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Your colony has 200 homes. If each home saves 10 litres of water a day by closing taps while brushing and washing, how much is saved in 30 days? What could that water be used for?
prompt_hi: Tumhari colony mein 200 ghar hain. Agar har ghar brush aur haath-muh dhote waqt nal band karke roz 10 litre paani bachaaye, toh 30 din mein kitna paani bachega? Us paani ka kya upyog ho sakta hai?
answer: 200 times 10 times 30 is 60,000 litres a month, enough to fill about 3,000 buckets of 20 litres, or several water tankers; it could water gardens and trees or serve families in summer.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Make a 7-day 'no plastic challenge' chart with a row for each day and columns for cloth bag, own bottle and no plastic wrapper. After the week, turn your ticks into a bar graph.
prompt_hi: 7 din ka 'no plastic challenge' chart banao: har din ki ek line aur kapde ka thaila, apni bottle aur bina plastic wrapper ke columns. Hafte ke baad apne ticks ko bar graph mein badlo.
answer: A chart of days by actions with ticks; a bar graph with one bar per day showing how many plastic-free actions were done; it shows which day or action was hardest and whether things improved.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Bunty says, 'I'm just one kid. Even if I stop using plastic straws, it won't change anything.' What would you tell him?
prompt_hi: Bunty kehta hai, 'Main toh bas ek bachcha hoon. Agar main plastic straw chhod bhi doon, toh kuch nahi badlega.' Tum use kya bologe?
answer: One child's straws add up to hundreds in a year, and others copy what they see, friends and family; when many people do it, it makes a big difference, and shops change what they sell.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Explain to your family your plan to care for the Earth for one week: what you will do, why it matters, and how you will check it.
prompt_hi: Apni family ko ek hafte ka dharti bachaao plan samjhao: kya karoge, ye kyon zaroori hai, aur kaise check karoge.
answer: Specific actions, such as a cloth bag, a steel bottle, closing taps and sorting waste; why: refusing and reducing make less waste, and small actions add up across many people; checking: a 7-day tick chart reviewed together at the end.

subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: what do the 3 Rs stand for?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: 3 R ka matlab kya hai?
answer: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle.
